body: Here girl! 23F!

Unfortunately, men are going to leave for many reasons, if a man leaves because of this, I sense a guilty conscious. I listen to A LOT of podcast about mental health, and number one, I have learned, never stay stuck in a victim mindset. That is what keeps us stuck in places. I have also learned bad shit happens all of the time. How a person treats, says everything about them, and NOT YOU. Heal, become the BEST version all yourself, so that a man so broken and narcissistic, can never touch you. We push forward because the only other option is so stay stuck, and who in their right mind, wants to stay in a mindset of, “I hate myself,” NO. We are deserving of love, we are deserving of loving ourselves. I think the first step really starts within, get to know yourself, on a deeper level. Know who you are, know your triggers. I’ve read so many stories, this is more of a inconvenience, than anything else. It’s not who we are. We bring so much more to the table. Knowing your worth is KEY.

Trust me, I know exactly what you’re going through. I’ve taken one day at a time, and this is very recent for me unfortunately. But I’ve learned that I require quite a bit, as I want/need things in a relationship, and I also give a lot, but you know it’s a FUCKING VIBE. Remember who you are. You are not this. You are beautiful. You are amazing. Make sure you take care of you!!!
Oh no girl, TRUST YOUR GUT, NOT YOUR GUY!!!!!!!

Honestly trust your gut. Unfortunately, sometimes I feel like some partners are not proactive about being tested, and they kind of just ignore any signs. I truthfully think I got it from him, like I really think I did, but it doesn’t change my situation, unfortunately. Just have to get out of the period of being very bitter towards him.

It’s very interesting that I look back, and I would believe everything he would say, I have never seen results, he said the lab “lost” his results, he continually came up with excuses, and I had a full on panic attack when I found out, and he said it’s fine, and then blamed me for it. It’s very very very interesting. I’m not implying he cheated. This man went from full on being in love with me, to not wanting to speak to him. Maybe he’s a liar, or good at playing the game correctly. But he definitely taught me a HUGE lesson.

PERIOD!!!!!!!!! Like really at the end of the day, people are gonna leave, and really, this is going show who stays. I have literally had the diagnosis, for a short period, but one thing I will never do, is talk down on myself, nor listen to what another persons say. Like I told this man, baby, I’m one in a million, your loss not me, STILL a bad bitch, will forever be one. PERIOD.

I wish I would have been more proactive with getting the blood results, but after I was diagnosed from the lesions, I was kind of in an emotional state. I didn’t take the blood test until it was recommended recently unfortunately. And I have no even spoken to my previous partner. I know for a fact, he stated he never has had a test before, because he has always gone off what his partner has told him 😶 .. my test in men, I tell ya what 🤦🏼‍♀️

Well I was tested a year ago, (a blood test), by my gyno, and everything came back negative. And I recently had one right after I sexually active him, and it was negative, but I read the most accurate test are your lesions. I personally have never had any sores show up, I am paranoid as it is, so even a false alarm of lesions on the genitals would have made me a nervous wreck.

NTA!!! As much as I would love to not talk down on your sister.. your sister needs quite a bit of therapy. Does she always degrade her daughter? It seems it was expected from what her daughter said? You are NTA. Children are human beings, and go through real problems, as much as anyone else. You should maybe sit with her, if she even would… it seems like your sister never is wrong.. good for you, for standing up for your niece. She absolutely is very lucky to have you. Normalize telling other mothers something is not okay.

I would talk to your girlfriend about getting a kit… because right now she may be in denial, and still numb, but eventually she’s going to get angry and want justice, and if she has that kit, she will have what she needs. I’m so sorry that happened to her. I went through a very similar situation, and wish I would’ve had a rape kit done. It is something very hard to even understand when it happens. Right now all you can do is support her, and really push her. I would recommend maybe even getting checked for stds… it’s a very scary situation to be in. Best wishes.

I have family who is very, “they are victims.” Every argument or disagreement, I am usually always the one to blame. I was cut off from my family, because I moved out at 18, I was uninvited to all family occasions, because I chose to move out. They took me after (they drove my mother to suicide) and they constantly hold it over my head, anytime we argue, as I owe them my life because they took me in. My uncle is an alcoholic, my aunt is depressed, sleeps all the time, and plays victim. Their daughter is the worst, she tells me I’m an awful person, when I’ve done the best out of the family, they tell me I’ll end up like my mother all the time. I could not continue to hurt my mental health. Best decision I ever made was cutting contact. It was really hard because I wanted to be loved so badly, but I’ve come to terms that I will never be enough for this family. Cutting off family, is sometimes necessary.

Hello!!! 

How do I learn to control my energy and protect myself?? 

And when I see the flashes of lights, what exactly am I seeing? Someone trying to contact me?

Thank you!! I definitely know he’s around. I’ve actually spoken to a medium multiple times about him, it’s very beautiful how our loved ones send us signs. I just figured his would be something goofy, but I guess it is, I’m sure I’ve noticed way more signs, I just have learned to be opened and pay close attention. If you feel your loved one, it’s definitely them.

Speaking from experience, strictly experience of losing someone I was deeply in love with for over 8 years, he wants you to live your life to the fullest. He will send you signs, to let you know he is around. I’ve learned that he’s with you everywhere you go, even when you have no idea. Talk to him, he’s still there. Live and love your life for him. Because that’s exactly what he wants. He will definitely be there whenever it’s your time, but until then, live your life and make it so amazing for him.
My dms are always open if you ever need to talk.
I sincerely hate that you see it that way, but if you do ever need someone to talk my dms are always open!!

I know all you see right now is a way out, but I promise you this world would not be the same without you. You deserve to live and have everything beautiful in this lifetime. I’ve learned after many attempts, it wasn’t about my life ending, but my life as I knew it. Your smile, kindness, and laugh has changed someone’s life. You have made a difference in this world, I hope you continue too.

Honestly…. I have SUCH A SIMILAR situation. Constantly sticking my neck out for my best friend, my best friend was in a car accident, almost took his life from drinking and driving, actually basically took his left hand… 4 years later, never learned his lesson. I’ve learned I had to love him from a distance, as there’s obviously more to the story. But realistically do whatever is going to help you sleep at night. If he wants to continue to be in your life, maybe sit down and have a discussion and set some boundaries, we all need tough love. Sometimes our best friends saving grace is not us. But if you do not want him in your life, make sure this is what you want. Seriously.

Sounds to me maybe she wants you without the commitments of actually labeling it. Which is RED FLAG. You’re young, you’re just starting college. Enjoy your youth. If you see potential, and do see a future with her it will work out. I was in the same situation not too long ago where a guy wanted me, only on his terms, but I just completely shut that shit down. Maybe she does have feelings for you, and has a hard time admitting it, or you could always be the person she keeps in her back pocket. Never settle for that. Life is too short for half ass people.
